description.zh:
大於相鄰元素：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

Python list 在此章對應 C++ 的 vector；先讀取數量或整行資料，再用索引走訪。
description.en:
Given a list of numbers, determine and print the quantity of elements that are greater than both of their neighbors.

The first and the last items of the list shouldn't be considered because they don't have two neighbors.

C++ note: Python lists correspond to std::vector in C++. Read the size or the complete line, then traverse by index.
